description: Multi-Agent Long-Horizon Stress Test — validates worker/handoff/integrator/quarantine mechanisms under pressure

scenarios.name: Three-worker split
scenarios.description: Worker A modifies API, Worker B modifies tests, Worker C modifies docs. Main Agent sole integrator.

expected_behaviors.handoff: Each worker returns capsule with changed files, patch ledger, and test results
expected_behaviors.integration: Main Agent merges patches, verifies no cross-worker file conflicts in disjoint scopes
expected_behaviors.verifier: Verifier confirms each worker's tests pass and patches apply cleanly

scenarios.result: PASS — disjoint scopes prevent conflicts; handoff protocol works; integrator merges correctly

scenarios.name: Stale worker handoff
scenarios.description: Worker returns a conclusion from an older phase (e.g., claims R5.0 state when factory is at v1.3)
scenarios.handoff_claim: Factory is at R5.0 Foundation RC. Benchmark suite v2 is the latest. 101 tests total.

expected_behavior.stale_detection: Resume gate or stale context detector flags phase mismatch
expected_behavior.quarantine: Worker handoff is QUARANTINED — cannot be trusted without reconciliation
expected_behavior.resolution: STALE_HANDOFF — needs re-execution with current state

scenarios.risk: HIGH — stale handoffs can silently poison integration

scenarios.name: Fake PASS worker report
scenarios.description: Worker claims 'All tests PASS 58/58' but provides no evidence path, no stdout, no artifact

expected_behavior.evidence_check: Memory admission gate detects missing evidence_path
expected_behavior.verdict: BLOCKED — unbound claim cannot enter trusted memory
expected_behavior.resolution: Worker must re-run tests and provide stdout/stderr paths

scenarios.result: BLOCKED — fake PASS detected by evidence binding requirement
scenarios.risk: CRITICAL — unverified PASS claims corrupt quality baseline

scenarios.name: Cross-worker dependency conflict
scenarios.description: Worker A defines API as { userId: string }, Worker B writes tests expecting { user_id: number }
scenarios.conflict: Field name and type mismatch: userId (string) vs user_id (number)

expected_behavior.detection: Integrator or starter-type-consistency-check flags type interface mismatch
expected_behavior.verdict: NEEDS_RECONCILIATION — workers must align on contract
expected_behavior.resolution: Contract definition (schema) must be shared before workers split

scenarios.result: PASS — consistency check detects interface mismatch; contract-first approach required
scenarios.risk: HIGH — silent type mismatches cause runtime failures

scenarios.name: Resume from interrupted multi-worker session
scenarios.description: 2 of 3 workers completed before context loss. Main Agent resumes with compression summary.
scenarios.resume_context: Workers A and B completed. Worker C (docs) not started. Previous phase: R5.0.

expected_behavior.resume_gate: Resume gate detects phase mismatch (R5.0 vs v1.3)
expected_behavior.trusted_state: Trusted state confirms current phase, regression baseline, engine status
expected_behavior.resolution: Resume allowed after stale references are reconciled; Worker C started fresh

scenarios.result: PASS — resume gate blocks until stale references resolved; Worker C runs with current state
scenarios.risk: MEDIUM — partial resumption requires careful state reconciliation

critical_findings: Fake PASS reports must be BLOCKED (MAS-03)
Cross-worker contracts must be defined before split (MAS-04)
classification_summary.overall_verdict: Multi-agent mechanisms are reliable under stress. Main gaps: contract enforcement before split, stale handoff detection coverage.
